prompt: Generate one image: a finished, high-fidelity desktop website landing page design, 16:9 landscape, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no browser window, no device, no desk). Two images are attached. Image 1 shows the REAL Lonca logomark and icon: reproduce that exact mark (pixel-block icon + blocky "lonca" wordmark), single flat colour (light on dark), never redraw or restyle it. Image 2 is a STYLE reference sheet only (Nango primary, plus Linear, Vercel, Resend): match its craft, near-black ground, hairline grid lines framing a centred content column, crisp neutral greys, one accent colour, refined grotesk type, small mono labels, real code cards; do NOT copy any of their text, logos or products. Product: Lonca, an open-source-engine marketplace integrator for Turkish marketplace sellers (Trendyol, Hepsiburada; n11 coming). The seller panel is coming soon, small sellers will always be free, the open-source TypeScript SDKs exist today. Accent colour: Lonca blue #3D7BE0 on near-black #0A0B0D, text #EDEFF2, muted #8A919C, hairlines #1E2228. All page text in Turkish. Composition B (Linear-like centred hero with a large product view below). 1. Top nav: exact Lonca logomark left; links "Satıcılar", "Geliştiriciler", "Fiyatlar", "Dokümanlar"; right: GitHub star chip and white pill "Bekleme listesi". 2. Hero, left-aligned in a narrow column at the top: headline set large "Pazaryeri entegrasyonu, yıllık lisans olmadan.", subline "Açık kaynak motorlu entegratör. Lonca Panel yakında; küçük satıcıya her zaman ücretsiz.", and on the right of the subline row an inline email field "E-posta adresin" + accent button "Bekleme listesine yazıl". 3. THE FOCAL MOVE: a wide, large dark product window beneath the hero, filling most of the width, rising out of a soft grey radial glow (like Linear): a seller panel with left sidebar (Siparişler, Ürünler, Stok, İadeler, Ayarlar), a main order table with Turkish order numbers, ₺ amounts and channel tags Trendyol / Hepsiburada, and a right-side detail drawer showing one order; a small badge "Konsept · örnek veri" at its top-right corner. 4. Very bottom, the start of the next section: a thin row "Trendyol · canlıda doğrulandı   Hepsiburada · canlıda doğrulandı   n11 · geliştiriliyor". Body text at real readable size. Real content only: no customer logos, no testimonials, no user counts, no marketplace logos (names in plain text are fine), no competitor names, no prices for paid plans.
